text:
marta: Heads-up: we need to prioritize onboarding 'Labyrinth-70b' this sprint. Can folks drop quick scores for perf/quality/cost/regression risk + suggested next action? I'll compile into the heatmap.

sahil: Added a sheet -> https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LabyrinthScore (placeholder). I put rough perf & cost estimates from the eval harness.

jon: I can run quant experiments (fp16 / int8 / awq) — have 2 A100s Thu-Fri. Suggested runs: int8-static, int8-dynamic, awq-4. Will push scripts to /infra/quant/runs and post job ids.

lee: Flag: earlier 65b quant showed coding hallucination ↑ on our CodeBench runs. Mark regression risk = high for quantized 70b until we validate on CodeEval.

eva: Product note: roadmap Q3 wants a low-latency embedding/generation pair. Prioritize models with good short-prompt latency and stable tokenization. If Labyrinth has edge on instruction-following, it's a plus.

marta: Quick scoring convention: 1-5 for perf / quality / cost / regression (1=best for perf/quality, but for cost/regression 1=low risk/cost). I'll normalize to a weighted score (weights: perf 0.3, quality 0.4, cost 0.2, regression 0.1). Add numbers by EOD.

jon: Quick command I'll run (will post real logs later):
```
python quant_runner.py --model labyrinth-70b --mode int8 --batch 1 --seq 256
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: quant job queued: job_id=q-20260324-17, queue_pos=4

sahil: :thumbsup: I added a note on dataset coverage — we need more multi-turn dialogs and code-multi-file cases for regen tests.

lee: Proposing eval set: CodeEval, ConvAssist, CoreBench-5. Will run with temp sweep (0.0, 0.2, 0.7) and compute EM / F1 for code tasks and Rouge/ChrF for general.

eva: :eyes: If we see >5% drop in code EM after quant, deprioritize for embeddings rollout.

marta: OK. Tentative next steps: jon runs quant jobs; lee runs codebench; sahil completes heatmap with cost numbers. Wed 10am sync to finalize. @everyone please add rows by tomorrow noon.

jon: Noted — I'll post run summaries and a small CSV with token latency percentiles (p50/p90/p99).

lee: Also: capture KV cache size and peak mem in runs — important when selecting awq config vs int8.

sahil: Added cost-estimate column (gpu-hours x $). FYI dedicated slot pricing will affect Dedicated vs Hosted recommendation.

marta: :raised_hands: thanks team. I'll put this on the model review board draft and share the heatmap link once compiled.
